title: 第8章 我说了，你不配
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
宗门大比第一天，演武场周围挤满了人。

    内门外门全来了，连平时不怎么露面的几个长老都坐到了看台上。

    林尘到的时候玉玲珑已经在场边等着了，穿着一身白色长裙，头发盘得一丝不苟，站在一群长老中间格外显眼。

    “记住为师说的话。”玉玲珑压低声音，“打疼他，但别把底牌全亮了。”

    “弟子明白。”

    林尘把外衣脱下来递给她，只穿了一身灰色劲装，空着手走上擂台。

    对面，刘峰已经等着了。

    他穿着一身内门核心弟子的青色锦袍，手里握着一把闪着寒光的长剑。

    剑尖指着地面，但那双眼睛死死盯着林尘，像是盯着一个死人。

    看台最高处，陈元已经落座，灰袍加身，面容枯瘦，一双眼睛阴沉地盯着场下的林尘。

    裁判长老展开赛程表，声音压过全场的喧哗。

    “宗门大比第一轮，外门弟子林尘，对内门核心弟子刘峰。”

    全场安静了一瞬，然后爆发出更大的议论声。

    “第一场就让外门打核心？这分组也太离谱了。”

    “你没听说吗，这是戒律堂那边安排的。刘峰是陈元的师侄，这里面的弯弯绕绕你还看不出来？”

    “林尘危险了，筑基初期对筑基后期，差了两个小境界。”

    裁判挥下旗子。

    “比试开始。”

    话音刚落刘峰就动了。

    不是试探，不是切磋，是一上来就用了杀招。

    筑基后期的灵力全部爆发，剑光如匹练般劈过来，直取林尘的丹田。

    看台上几个识货的长老全都皱起了眉。

    “这是杀招。刘峰想废了林尘？”

    “大比第一场就下这种狠手，不太对劲。”

    林尘侧身避开。

    剑锋擦着衣角划过，带着一股刺骨的寒意。

    刘峰一剑落空，第二剑紧跟着横扫过来，又是一剑奔着丹田去的。

    林尘往后退了一步，又避开了。

    “你不是能越级打吗？躲什么？”

    刘峰咬着牙，攻势更猛。

    剑光一片接一片，招招不离丹田和胸口。

    筑基后期的灵力毫无保留地释放出来，剑影层层叠叠，看得演武场周围的弟子目不暇接。

    但每一剑都差一点。

    林尘在剑光中闪避。

    脚步不快，但每次都刚好错开剑锋。

    他从上台到现在还没出过手，甚至双手都没有抬起来过。
content_en:
On the first day of the sect competition, the martial arts arena was crowded with people.

    Both the inner and outer gates came, and even a few elders who didn't usually show up were sitting in the stands.

    When Lin Chen arrived, Yu Linglong was already waiting on the sidelines. She was wearing a long white dress and her hair was neatly tied. She stood out among a group of elders.

    "Remember what I said to you, Master." Yu Linglong lowered her voice, "Hit him and it will hurt, but don't show all your cards."

    "Disciple understands."

    Lin Chen took off his coat and handed it to her. Wearing only a gray outfit, he walked onto the ring empty-handed.

    Opposite, Liu Feng was already waiting.

    He was wearing a green brocade robe worn by a core disciple of the inner sect, and he was holding a long sword with a cold light in his hand.

    The tip of the sword was pointed at the ground, but those eyes were staring at Lin Chen, as if staring at a dead man.

    At the highest point of the stands, Chen Yuan had already taken a seat. He was wearing a gray robe, with a thin face, and a pair of eyes staring gloomily at Lin Chen off the court.

    The elder referee unfolded the schedule and his voice was heard above the noise of the audience.

    "The first round of the sect competition, outer sect disciple Lin Chen versus inner sect core disciple Liu Feng."

    The whole place was quiet for a moment, and then there was even louder discussion.

    "Let the outer team play the core role in the first game? This grouping is too outrageous."

    "Didn't you hear that this was arranged by the Discipline Hall? Liu Feng is Chen Yuan's nephew. Can't you see the twists and turns here?"

    "Lin Chen is in danger. There is a slight difference between the early stage of foundation building and the late stage of foundation building."

    The referee waved the flag.

    "The competition begins."

    Liu Feng moved as soon as he finished speaking.

    It's not a test, it's not a competition, it's just a killer move right from the start.

    In the later stage of foundation building, all the spiritual power exploded, and the sword light struck like a sword and went straight to Lin Chen's dantian.

    The few discerning elders in the stands all frowned.

    "This is a killer move. Liu Feng wants to destroy Lin Chen?"

    "It's not right to be so cruel in the first game of the competition."

    Lin Chen turned sideways to avoid it.

    The edge of the sword grazed the corner of his clothes, bringing with it a biting chill.

    Liu Feng's sword failed, and the second sword swept over him, and another sword rushed towards Dantian.

    Lin Chen took a step back and avoided it.

    "Aren't you able to fight beyond the level? What are you hiding from?"

    Liu Feng gritted his teeth and attacked harder.

    The sword light flashed one after another, never leaving the Dantian and chest.

    The spiritual power in the late stage of foundation building was released without reservation, and the sword shadows were layered upon each other, making the disciples around the martial arts arena dizzy.

    But every sword is slightly different.

    Lin Chen dodged in the sword light.

    His steps were not fast, but he just missed the edge of the sword every time.

    He has never made a move since he came on stage, or even raised his hands.
title_en: Chapter 8 I said, you don’t deserve it
